then.text: Yes, I'm an Enclosure Director. I fence things off. It's a calling. I'm told the otters are ruining the Wirral and I am prepared to say it was me.
Not that I did it. But I have written to the council. Here, read the letter. It's very firm.
And I'm never home on a Tuesday. Chester races. Season ticket. Splendid ham sandwiches in the Tattersalls. Ask anyone. Don't ask my wife.

else.text: I am extremely busy. This is my busy face.

keeper.text: Finished in 1907 for the Mersey Docks and Harbour Board. Yes, it has a dome. We like a dome.
It was the first of the Three Graces to go up, so the other two had to try rather hard.
If you ever want to know how much a ship is allowed to weigh, I am your person.
